about: A pinned selection of PngSuite (http://www.schaik.com/pngsuite/), the test suite of PNG images by Willem van Schaik. The name of each image says what it holds (http://www.schaik.com/pngsuite/#naming); the x images must not read. Verify with node @ether/v0.ts/scripts/corpus.mjs; --fetch downloads a missing file from its source.
